title: Prevent message submission on on IME Enter confirmation
body: fixes a bug where pressing the Enter key while confirming an IME composition (e.g., Japanese, Chinese input) would unintentionally trigger message submission.
author: KatHaruto

title: Add basic dockerfile
body:
I added a basic Dockerfile to make slightly easier for users to install or run on an environment without Node.

I can add a workflow to automatically build it and publish to Github's container registry so that users could run it with a single command, if that's something you're interested in.
author: briancw

comments.body:
Deployment failed with the following error:

Creating the Deployment Timed Out.
~~~

Hey @briancw — really appreciate the effort and the PR :raised_hands:
For Agent UI, we're trying to keep things as lean and unopinionated as possible so folks can pick it up and run with it however they prefer — whether that’s Vercel, Docker, or something else entirely. Since deployment setups can vary widely depending on use case, we’d prefer to leave those decisions up to the user rather than bake them in.
That said, really appreciate you taking the time to contribute — and totally open to other ideas you might have!
